root: Uni-CLI 0.225.3 is the scholarly-resource closure release: agents can now discover, compare, download, read, audit, and classify academic resources through source-grounded commands instead of stopping at metadata or PDF URL discovery.

Source-scoped full-text and PDF reading now covers arXiv, ACL Anthology, OpenReview, PubMed/PMC, bioRxiv, medRxiv, CVF, NeurIPS, PMLR, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and Unpaywall where the source exposes real text or PDF artifacts.

The scholar coverage and routing surfaces now expose source-fulltext, resource, citation, provenance, and fail-closed availability signals so missing PDFs remain explicit metadata records rather than hallucinated papers.

This release also replaces the obsolete CNKI YAML adapter with the typed KNS-backed adapter and keeps generated manifests, operation policy, capability policy, README, AGENTS, docs, and stats synchronized through the release gates.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.225.3 是 scholarly-resource closure release：agent 现在可以通过 source-grounded commands 完成学术资源发现、对比、下载、阅读、审计和分类，而不是停在 metadata 或 PDF URL discovery。
Source-scoped full-text/PDF reading 现在覆盖 arXiv、ACL Anthology、OpenReview、PubMed/PMC、bioRxiv、medRxiv、CVF、NeurIPS、PMLR、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar、Unpaywall，前提是来源真实暴露 text 或 PDF artifact。
Scholar coverage 与 routing surface 现在暴露 source-fulltext、resource、citation、provenance、fail-closed availability 信号；缺 PDF 的记录保持为显式 metadata record，不伪造成已读论文。
本次 release 也用 typed KNS-backed adapter 替换旧 CNKI YAML adapter，并通过 release gates 同步 generated manifests、operation policy、capability policy、README、AGENTS、docs、stats。
